title: 1998 AHSME Problem 11
statement: Let \(R\) be a rectangle. How many circles in the plane of \(R\) have a diameter both of whose endpoints are vertices of \(R?\)

solutions.text: The four sides determine four distinct diameter circles. The two diagonals are equal and share a midpoint, so they determine the same fifth circle. Hence there are \(5,\) and D is correct.
hints: There are six unordered pairs of rectangle vertices
